body.name: Compact-locally honest observed-panel band sequences
body.construction: \(\mathfrak H^{\mathrm{panel}}_{1-\alpha}(\theta_0,v_0;M,L_0)=\{\{\widetilde C_n\}_{n\ge1}:\widetilde C_n(v)\text{ is a randomized measurable interval based only on the observed Gaussian panel, and }\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{u\in\mathcal U}\Pr_{P_{\theta_n(u)}}[R_{P_{\theta_n(u)}}(v_n(t))\in\widetilde C_n(v_n(t))\ \forall t\in\mathcal D]\ge1-\alpha\}\).
